title: On the Band
text: Since Landfall, Marrow's voice is on the colony's band most nights. Not the old call for humans: talk. Weather, crops, how her people answer their children's questions. {who} has started leaving it on while they work. "She isn't wrong about everything," they say, not quite to you.

choices.label: Leave the channel open
choices.reply: It's their band. It stays open.

choices.label: "What isn't she wrong about?"
choices.reply: "That nobody asked us," they say. "About any of it."

notes: STORY.md §9 beat 1: "Your Autonomists start listening." At home after Landfall (stance effects need the colony, so it waits for Touchdown).
